what: Entry gate covering the first page full screen: a video plays behind it (one randomly picked from a list, looped without sound), with a wordmark in the center and a single Enter line below. Clicking anywhere on the gate (or pressing Enter or Esc) lifts it in .5s and releases scrolling. Once lifted it does not show again for a day (the ?opening in the URL=if true, always shown)

options.days: Days before it shows again after being closed, default 1 — 0 means it shows every time it opens
options.key: localStorage name to remember, default fx-video-enter-gate
options.lock: If false, scrolling is not locked while the door is floating
options.narrow: Width (px) at which it switches to the phone video list, default 767
options.video[data-srcs]: Video URL list (comma-separated) — one is picked at random each time. data-src-narrow is the list for phones
options.[data-fx-part=video·mark·enter]: Background video · wordmark in the center · Enter button below (the whole door is clickable even without it)
options.--fx-enter-bottom: Enter button distance from the bottom (via style), default 4.3rem
options.fx:open · fx:enter: When the door opens · closes, fired from the element (bubbles)

use: BRAND
note: The original keeps the cookie site_visited for one day, and the video picks one of ten versions (landscape 1920×1080 10s · phone portrait 750×1334 10s). The retract curve is the GSAP default (.5s power1.out) as is

from.where: index.html .hm-opening + index.js — original #Opening (VisitManager cookie one day · splashVideoList random · gsap.to opacity 0 in openingModal.close)
